review_kind: successor exact authority transaction contract after skeptic verdict 0075

supersedes.disposition: Prior evidence remains untouched; this successor resolves all four Major families before RED.

authority.phase: Design only; RED remains disabled pending fresh independent zero-Critical/Major skeptic verdict.
authority.sole_writer: Only concrete CapturedAuthorizationAuthority owns P4 live-state reservation, admission reserve/consume, complete batch commit, session identity/start record, legacy denial, and opaque interning. CapturedAuthorizationContract signs/parses/verifies bytes only; it has no writer, store, admission, session/event handle, or hidden spend callback.

public_contracts.LifecycleAuthority: Abstract set remains exactly produce, seal, publish, capture, open_capture. Existing v1 subclasses and ordinary-v1 handles retain behavior. CapturedAuthorizationAuthority is a separate opt-in public LifecycleAuthority subclass; no LifecycleAuthority abstract method changes.

CapturedAuthorizationAuthority.method: authorize_capture_set(captures, admission_ref, *, consumer_run_identity, process_measurement_sha256, runtime_sha256, transition_nonces) -> tuple[CapturedAuthorizationRecord, LaunchSession]
CapturedAuthorizationAuthority.input: captures is exact built-in tuple of exact built-in (published,frozen,derived_port) tuples in PlannedCaptureSet order; admission_ref is exact built-in {kind,role,schema,sha256} IssuanceBasisRef.v1 for action-execution-admission or final-replay-admission. No caller artifact bytes, signer, resolver, store, path, URL, provider, session, callback, or per-call dependency.
CapturedAuthorizationAuthority.output: Record and LaunchSession(kind=captured-authorization-v2) are opaque, non-copyable, non-pickleable, non-mapping, identity-bound. Record exposes no bytes/dict/path/member/provider/signer/store; P4 session has no legacy stream/capture capability.

CapturedAuthorizationContract.held_dependencies: trusted resolver snapshot factory, Ed25519 keyring, trusted clock, immutable revocation authority, all constructed once and retained privately
methods: mint_replay_evidence(plan, reservation, ports, receipts, authorization_set) -> bytes|None
verify_complete(snapshot, plan, reservation, ports, receipts, authorization_set, replay_evidence) -> SessionDecision
CapturedAuthorizationContract.denial: No reserve/consume/rollback, batch write, session construction/intern, event append, member/provider open, import/construct/run/output, writer handle or spend callback. reservation is immutable descriptive evidence made by authority transaction, never a writer.

TrustedArtifactResolver.seam: Held WORM resolver/store, not caller selected. snapshot() returns one immutable generation; resolve(snapshot, exact IssuanceBasisRef.v1) returns canonical bytes with matching SHA-256 or refuses. No path/URL/import/callback/fallback/ambient lookup/caller-selected store/generation.
TrustedArtifactResolver.closure: Preflight recursively resolves selected admission, every signed artifact, every IssuanceBasis.v1 and each exact ref in one snapshot. It independently verifies canonical grammar, schema, named self, Ed25519 signature, issuer role/key use, time/revocation, exact basis kind/ref set, no cycle/future output, and PEA/CES/BVP/CAS/PCE/admission plus action StageAdmission or replay FinalManifest/FinalReplayEntry and predecessor publication receipt. Missing/wrong/substituted/unavailable/non-WORM/duplicate/extra content refuses before reservation.

CapturedAuthorizationStore.seam: Held dedicated WORM transaction store, invisible to callers and contract
CapturedAuthorizationStore.begin: begin(execution_key, admission_identity) serializes exact-admission/exact-key contenders in this live authority instance
operations: reserve_admission(plan) checks Unused and makes transaction-local Reserved(transaction_id) before first port mint

commit(batch) requires Reserved, independently verified complete artifacts, one SessionDecision, canonical SessionStartRecord and frozen live projection; it atomically writes one WORM batch and changes Reserved to Committed/consumed
abort() idempotently removes only uncommitted reservation/P4 mark; no consumption/batch/session/event/receipt remains and corrected retry is legal
CapturedAuthorizationStore.key_batch: execution_key is canonical (study_id, canonical execution_authority_ref bytes, logical_execution_id, run_id), admission_identity exact schema/digest. One put-if-absent batch holds admission identity, ordered port/receipt bytes, set bytes, replay bytes or action-none, SessionDecision, SessionStartRecord, session identity/nonce. No partial artifact/session/event visible; conflict or byte-different repeat refuses.

states_and_transaction.p4_binding: At P4 entry under lifecycle lock, authority validates exact tuple/cardinality/order/duplicates/ports/run/nonces/PUBLISHED heads, freezes independent live fingerprints and marks identities p4-reserved before preflight. Failure/abort removes only this mark; commit makes p4-committed. Legacy capture winning first is ordinary v1 but advances PUBLISHED head, forcing later P4 refusal with no P4 session.
order: Acquire held resolver snapshot and preflight: no signer/admission/store/legacy receipt/session/event/member-provider open/import/construct/run/output effect before success.

Begin held transaction, revalidate live heads/fingerprints, reserve_admission(plan), then mint ports, matching receipts, set, replay evidence only for replay; action requires None and does not call replay mint.

verify_complete using same snapshot and copied/reparsed outputs; revalidate live projection/heads/nonces/key; compute canonical SessionStartRecord/identity; commit one batch; only then intern/return opaque objects.
states_and_transaction.minted_authority: After Reserved, drafts are minted but nonauthoritative and unobservable outside transaction: no usable port/receipt/set/replay/session/event. At one commit admission becomes Committed/consumed and all artifacts/session-start become authoritative simultaneously. This meets ADR-0125 first-port consume-before-mint without irreversible pre-store burn or signing-contract writer.
states_and_transaction.scope: Exact concurrency guarantee is through this live authority/held transaction store. Packet 4 does not claim restart-safe locking, durable cross-process consume-once, reconstruction, or F5A-R23 closure.

artifact_adjacency: Ports, receipts, set, SessionDecision and replay evidence share selected action/replay admission execution_authority_ref/logical_execution_id/run_id, study/subject/document contract/document/purpose and PEA/CES/BVP/CAS/plan/planned-set exactly.

P(CES)==P(BVP)==P(CAS)==P(StageAdmission or FinalReplayEntry)==ordered PlannedCaptureSet==ordered live captures; each PCE produces exactly one port/receipt; set/evidence are strict planned-entry-order projections.

Each exact ADR-0125 LifecycleCapturedReceipt.v2 binds port/PCE, predecessor publication receipt schema/digest, stream sequence/predecessor, consumer kind/id, actor_runtime_sha256 and WORM-unique nonce; no invented release equality.

Action decision has set/no replay evidence. Replay decision has final manifest/admission/entry/intent and exact replay evidence issued_ports equal set triples. Contract returns are frozen, canonically reparsed and independently verified before commit; aliases/post-return mutation/reorder/substitution refuse.
legacy_equivalent_entry_denials: LifecycleAuthority.capture and _DevelopmentBroker.capture refuse p4-reserved/p4-committed identities before legacy receipt/session/event; ordinary-v1 unchanged.

HistoricalStudyVerifier.capture and HistoricalStudyCaptureDriver.capture refuse P4-bound identities; authorize_capture_set is sole P4 route; existing facade/v1 behavior remains legacy until separately revised.

_DevelopmentBroker.open_capture, _DevelopmentBroker.captured_bindings, VerifiedCapture.member, CapturedMemberHandle.read_bytes/read_text, CapturedBindings.require/_consume_binding and _DevelopmentBroker.release refuse P4 record/session/identity. P4 creates no _Captured/VerifiedCapture capability.

descriptor, freeze_consumer_document, derive_consumer_port, provider/member helpers, receipt audit/recovery and direct constructor/copy/pickle/subclass/duck/wrapper/internal-table paths cannot mint P4 record/session or bypass denial.

failure_concurrency_retry.concurrent: Exactly one same-admission/key contender owns Reserved; others see no draft, refuse after commit or restart after abort. Different admissions/keys cannot share P4 live identity; WORM never overwrites.
failure_concurrency_retry.before_reserve: Validation/resolver/preflight/live failure clears mark and leaves no signer/admission/batch/legacy receipt/session/event/member-provider effect; retry allowed.
failure_concurrency_retry.reserved_precommit: Mint/parse/verify/revalidate/session-record failure aborts; drafts have no authority, admission returns Unused, no partial artifact/session/event visible; retry allowed.
failure_concurrency_retry.commit: Commit writes/consumes complete batch or nothing. A raised commit is unknown until held store resolves exact batch; no remint/resend. Committed resolution only interns same identity in live instance, never second session/event.
failure_concurrency_retry.postcommit: No effectful action remains because identity/start record committed. Intern/return failure cannot strand/duplicate event. This is commit/event atomicity, explicitly not durable/restart consume-once.

disposition_of_0075_majors.F5A-P4-P0-M02-legacy-capture-bypass: Addressed by P4 marks and every inventoried legacy/equivalent-route refusal while preserving v1.
disposition_of_0075_majors.F5A-P4-P0-M03-admission-consumption-tran: Addressed by one authority transaction: reserve before mint, atomic consume/complete verified commit, abort/retry, no contract writer/spend callback.
disposition_of_0075_majors.F5A-P4-P0-M04-unverifiable-issuance-basi: Addressed by held immutable WORM resolver snapshot recursively closing each artifact/basis/ref; caller chooses neither bytes nor resolver/path/generation.
disposition_of_0075_majors.F5A-P4-P0-M05-post-commit-session-event-: Addressed by session identity and SessionStartRecord in atomic batch; post-commit interning is non-effectful.

focused_red_matrix: Exact ABC/public signatures; opaque construction/copy/pickle/mapping/bytes/path/member/provider/signer, subclass/duck/wrapper, dependency swap/internal-table substitution.
Each legacy/equivalent route for reserved/committed action/replay plus ordinary-v1 positives.
Request/ref/runtime/nonce/order/cardinality/duplicate/live/head mutation and legacy-winning race P4 refusal/no P4 artifacts/session.
Order spies: preflight, reserve, ports, receipts, set, replay, verify, commit; no contract writer/store/admission/event capability.
Same-key concurrency/live collision/abort retry/every mint-verify-revalidate failure/malformed alias mutation/commit-raise resolution.
No partial batch; exact start/identity; postcommit intern failure; explicitly untested restart/durable R23 boundary.
ADR-0125 field/self/preimage/order/adjacency mutations; action/replay one/multiple happy paths; no import/open/construct/run/output/release.
